create.title: Add merchant
create.description: The system creates an API key for the merchant. The key is shown once.
create.name: Merchant name

validation.name: Enter the merchant name, up to 255 characters.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: The photo and address show to members on the voucher page.
edit.photoHint: Starts with http:// or https://. Leave empty to remove the photo.

validation.photo: Enter a valid http or https link, up to 2048 characters.
validation.address: The address is at most 255 characters.

rotate.title: Replace the API key?
rotate.description: The current key of {{name}} stops working at once. The merchant must use the new key to send orders and confirm codes.

key.title: API key of {{name}}
key.description: Copy the key now. Once you close this dialog it cannot be shown again.

rate.title: Value of a point
rate.text: The app pays a merchant this amount for each point a member redeems, and it is the price floor of vouchers.
rate.validation: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000.
rate.effectVouchers: Vouchers on sale must still meet their floor (the voucher value at least points price times point value), otherwise the change is refused.
rate.effectClosed: Closed months of the statement are recomputed at the new value on the issued and refunded lines.
rate.refused: Not changed: a voucher on sale would fall under its floor.

tier.description: A tier sets the multiplier on the points a member earns for each order.
tier.name: Tier name
tier.minSpendHint: Members who spent this much or more are placed in the tier. 0 is the starting tier.
tier.earnRateHint: From 0.01 to 999.99, at most two decimals. 1.5 means points times 1.5.
tier.effect: Members keep their current tier until their next evaluation (an order, a refund or the nightly job). New orders use the new multiplier at once.
tier.meaning: A member who spent {{spend}} in 12 months reaches this tier, and each point earned is multiplied by {{rate}}.

validation.name: Enter a tier name, up to 255 characters.
validation.minSpend: Enter a whole number from 0 to 9,999,999,999.
validation.earnRate: Enter a number from 0.01 to 999.99, at most two decimals.

tier.conflictName: A tier already has this name.
tier.conflictSpend: A tier already starts at this spend.
